title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (8/20): The Hangzhou Bay Bridge
note_en: 起来 after a verb often means "bringing things together into one": 把嘉兴和宁波两座城市连接起来 "links the two cities of Jiaxing and Ningbo." English needs no extra word here ("link," "connect"), but Chinese adds 起来 to show the separate parts end up joined, as in 收拾起来 "tidy up" or 联合起来 "unite." Note the 把 + object + verb + 起来 pattern.
